source_note: Iter-6 is not a review-emit walk. Triggered by user question 'have we achieved this?' testing whether the iter-5 work fully achieved the principle: 'sync is just an original openspec command that should be supported just because it's part of 1.3.1; don't say anything in the form of requirements or implementation around it.' Honest audit revealed iter-5 had cleaned the spec deltas + the most-egregious stale language but left ~10 places that still authored sync-as-orbit-decision framing.
user_choice: Option (b): strict-with-historical-cleanup — apply principle to forward-looking framing but KEEP task 1.3 (archive-summary-schema fix) because that stale text is actively wrong in shipped baseline.

cleanup_resolutions.action: Removed 'KEEP openspec-sync-specs SKILL' and 'KEEP /opsx:sync command' bullets entirely. Section now reads only the feedback DELETE bullet — sync retention is implicit per [[orbit-supports-full-openspec-1-3-1]].

Removed 'MODIFIES the Internal-run JSON summary format requirement to simplify the sync_specs parenthetical' clause. Capability summary now describes the legitimate orbit-conventions delta (RENAMED Distribution model + MODIFIED body + 2 ADDED) without the sync-only MODIFY.
Removed 'remove obsolete openspec-sync-specs direct-use mention' from install-instructions bullet — task 3.5 was removed in this same walk, leaving the proposal reference dangling.

Renamed section from 'Delete feedback, keep openspec-sync-specs' to 'Delete feedback skill from overlay'. Removed the 'openspec-sync-specs KEEP' bullet, the 'Why this asymmetry' framing, and the 'deprecated from direct user invocation' false-claim residue. Added single closing parenthetical noting all other upstream files stay implicitly under the project memory.

cleanup_resolutions.scope: design.md D-conventions-1 item 3 (Overlay file disposition category descriptions)
cleanup_resolutions.action: Removed 'e.g., openspec-sync-specs' example from Upstream-required primitive category. Removed entire parenthetical 'also user-callable command files for primitives that orbit retains but does not expose as a user surface (e.g., .claude/commands/opsx/sync.md ...)' from NOT shipped category. Categories now describe themselves without singling out sync.

Merged items 4 (MODIFY Internal-run JSON summary format) and 5 (MODIFY orbit-run-summary-emit Emit scope) into a single 'baseline-language drift deferred' item documenting both as REMOVED. Frames the removal under [[orbit-supports-full-openspec-1-3-1]] principle — orbit doesn't author requirements about upstream behavior orbit inherits implicitly.

Reframed 'Asymmetric upstream-file disposition (delete feedback, keep openspec-sync-specs)' as 'Per-skill prune judgment' — explains feedback is the one skill being pruned with rationale; future prune decisions need similar concrete justification. Drops the asymmetric framing that singled out sync as a special case.
Removed the long '(Note per iter-4 EW1-reversal: /opsx:sync command is RETAINED — upstream lists it as Optional command...)' parenthetical. Task 1.2 now describes only the feedback sweep.

cleanup_resolutions.scope: tasks.md task 3.5 (was: sweep README for sync mentions)
cleanup_resolutions.action: REMOVED entirely. README cleanup of sync mentions happens organically via task 2.3 (overlay terminology sweep) and task 3.4 (install verification rewrite under post-pegging framing) — no sync-specific task needed.

Removed '(Note per iter-4 EW1-reversal: /opsx:sync command is RETAINED in overlay; do NOT add a prune step for .claude/commands/opsx/sync.md.)' parenthetical. Task 3.6 now describes only the feedback rm step.
Removed '(including /opsx:sync — retained per iter-4 EW1-reversal)' callout. Task 5.5a now simply says 'Quick-reference command table lists all current opsx/* commands' without singling out sync.

cleanup_resolutions.scope: specs/orbit-conventions/spec.md MODIFIED Internal-run JSON summary format
cleanup_resolutions.action: REMOVED the entire MODIFIED requirement from the delta. Baseline's sync_specs parenthetical stays unchanged — its stale 'will be deprecated by #6' text is documented in design.md item 4-5 as known-issue deferred to future doc-hygiene change.

cleanup_resolutions.scope: specs/orbit-conventions/spec.md Overlay file disposition Upstream-required primitive scenario
cleanup_resolutions.action: Removed '(e.g., openspec-sync-specs, which orbit's archive flow invokes via subagent for delta-spec sync)' example from the scenario. Description now reads 'when orbit depends on an upstream skill as a callable primitive (invoked at the orchestration layer, not modified at the skill-body layer)' — describes the category without singling out sync-specs.

preserved_sync_references.rationale: Per option (b): archive-summary-schema.md:18 stale text is actively wrong in shipped baseline; cleanup task fixes it. Justified deviation from strict principle.
Historical: cites the 2 unmodified upstream skills that invalidated #6's premise.
Names what we're NOT doing (no positive sync decision).
Documents the structural removal per Codex EW1' principle — itself a non-decision marker.
Codex explicitly OK'd as historical record.

preserved_sync_references.location: orbit-conventions spec Commands scenario opsx/sync.md in 10+ command list
preserved_sync_references.rationale: Natural enumeration — sync appears among ~10 sibling commands without being singled out.
Refers to openspec archive's sync, not /opsx:sync.

post_resolution_state.principle_achieved: Forward-looking artifacts (proposal/specs/tasks) author zero requirements/implementation/decisions about sync. Remaining sync references all justified per option (b) — natural enumerations, historical/reversal records, or actively-wrong baseline cleanup.

final_assessment: Principle achieved per user verification. Sync is now treated as 'just an upstream command we naturally support' across all forward-looking change artifacts. 13 cleanup edits applied; 1 spec delta removed (MODIFIED Internal-run JSON summary format); 1 task removed (3.5); 4 tasks simplified (1.2, 3.6, 5.5a parentheticals stripped). 28→27 tasks, 13→12 deltas. Validates --strict.
next_recommended: Commit + push iter-5 + iter-6 work. Then /opsx:apply lean-overlay-and-add-orbit-onboard — proposal converged after 5 reviews + 6 address-reviews iterations + iter-6 principle-application cleanup. Cycle ROI definitively flattened; ready for implementation.
